profile_source: One recovery-owned IRecoveryCodePolicySource using existing version metadata/effective resolver; no generic policy/credential framework.

required_inputs.constraint: Explicit approved effective interval/provenance, exact supported implementation; HTTPS User BFF only. No browser policy/clock input or unsupported fallback.

Closed reviewed native RNG/encoding/canonicalization profile, distinct complete canonical output and bounded collision handling. Saved-code entropy accounting addresses current64-bit guidance. Figma's six examples and native default are not a production count/format.

Native Identity hasher/version/cost, bounded code length/set scan/hash work/concurrency and admission/rate policy; reject unsupported/malformed stored formats before expensive work. No inherited TOTP6digit/window/replay-retention or password-policy defaults.

Resolve the existing IAssurancePolicySource per operation/current execution; exact source/expected policy binding; lifetime clipped to current authorization/session/policy. No opaque-assurance ordering or new global session upgrade.

Explicit admission/current-set cardinality, exact old-set invalidation/linearization and any supported effects. No single-active-set, automatic preserve/revoke, first-use activation or replacement-order default.
Define display/download admission, payload format/fixed safe filename and lost-response status. No escrow, GET generation/redisclosure, browser delivery confirmation or silent retry.

required_inputs.input: Recovery consumption policy and trusted operation context
required_inputs.constraint: Exact Account/recovery operation/correlation/set-lifecycle/context/current-policy/expiry admission; recovery precedence and eventual effects remain011. No arbitrary Account/code boolean oracle or existing-strong-session assumption.
Classified minimum verifier/operation/audit metadata, hold/purge duties and explicit post-commit notification contract. No raw code in payload or invented legal duration/channel/finality.
Published provenance for required labels/errors/impact; absent required publication or unselected impact leaves the capability unavailable, not fabricated business copy.

finite_profile_rule: Tests may later supply complete labelled synthetic values explicitly. A minimal individual-consume fixture needs two distinct codes to prove one claim does not consume the other; this is a proposed finite scenario, not an approved production set count. No runtime profile is registered or activated here.
external_vault_requirement: No plaintext escrow or new pepper/key requirement is inferred. Reuse existing scoped vault transport only if an actual approved secret requirement is subsequently identified.
